metas.name: Kidnapped in Her Own Home: The Martha Carelli Story
metas.description: Follows Martha Carelli whose life is shattered when an escaped convict takes her hostage and forces her to drive his getaway car. She must outwit her increasingly volatile captor to survive.

metas.name: Made in Korea
metas.description: After her boyfriend's betrayal leaves her alone in Seoul, Shenba faces isolation and cultural differences. Through personal growth and new friendships, she finds strength and lasting connections.

metas.name: Miracle: The Boys of '80
metas.description: This is the story of the “Miracle on Ice,” when the 1980 US Hockey Team beat the USSR in the Olympic semi-finals at the height of the Cold War to bring home a gold medal. Their iconic underdog story is told with never-before-seen 16mm footage and firsthand reflections from the players who were brought back to the scene of their historic victory.

metas.name: AlMahaitiya
metas.description: A wealthy family loses their fortune and chooses to continue to fake affluence in an effort to keep up appearances.

metas.name: Who Is Martin Mull?
metas.description: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

metas.name: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
metas.description: This marks Mary Beth Barone's first hour-long comedy special.

metas.name: Poldi
metas.description: Footballer, entrepreneur, fan favorite and true community hero — Lukas Podolski reflects on his journey and what comes next in this intimate documentary.

metas.name: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
metas.description: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

metas.name: Sommore: Chandelier Fly
metas.description: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.

metas.name: The Last Salute
metas.description: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

metas.name: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
metas.description: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

metas.name: Dhamaal 4
metas.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

metas.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
metas.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

metas.name: 53 Sundays
metas.description: When three siblings agree to meet and discuss their aging father's future, their reunion spirals into bickering, bantering and reliving old grudges.

metas.name: The 51st AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
metas.description: Follows the 51st AFI Life Achievement Award ceremony honoring Eddie Murphy for his five-decade career in film, television and stand-up comedy.

metas.name: Yoh! Bestie
metas.description: Thando is perpetually unlucky in love, but when her bestie returns from his travels with a fiancée in tow, she's forced to face a new emotion — jealousy.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
metas.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

metas.name: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
metas.description: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

metas.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
metas.description: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.

metas.name: Unabomber
metas.description: In this drama inspired by true events, Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy to the infamous Unabomber unfolds as the FBI hunts him down.

metas.name: One Year to Live, Buy a Man
metas.description: Given a year to live, frugal 40-year-old Yui finally lets herself spend: "buying" nightclub host Sena. What begins as a contract takes an unexpected turn.

metas.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: After her husband's tragic death, Aleena joins the police force through a compassionate appointment. What begins as a quiet new chapter soon turns into a high-stakes battle of wits and courage, testing everything she believes about justice, loyalty, and herself.

metas.name: Possible Love
metas.description: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

metas.name: The Marked Woman
metas.description: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

metas.name: The Good Lawyer
metas.description: After a courtroom overdose lands him in rehab, a lawyer has one week to save his career and prepare for his own trial, with the help of a dogged intern.

metas.name: LEGO Friends: Heartlake the Musical
metas.description: Young Daisy turns to toy bricks as she finds herself trying to fit into a new school in a new country. When she stumbles across a mysterious key, she is transported to Heartlake City where she makes new friends. But they soon require her help to save a vital local landmark – with plenty of song and dance numbers along the way.

metas.name: The Rip
metas.description: Trust frays when a team of Miami cops discovers millions in cash inside a run-down stash house, calling everyone — and everything — into question.

metas.name: Brawlers
metas.description: Naïm is a sweetheart in everyday life but a beast when it comes to fighting. To afford treatment for his aging dog, he's forced to join "Hello Brawl", a service of street fighters resolving conflicts with punches.

metas.name: Sacrifice
metas.description: At a glitzy Greek island charity gala, a down-on-his-luck movie star lands the heroic role of a lifetime when a volcanic doomsday cult takes him hostage.

metas.name: Raja Shivaji
metas.description: The journey of the young Shivaji, who fought against the powers that be and was crowned as Chhatrapati monarch.

metas.name: Alpha
metas.description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

metas.name: To The Max
metas.description: Three skydivers died in similar accidents within five years. Salvador Calvo wanted to tell their stories with the sole survivor, Carlos Suárez.

metas.name: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
metas.description: In 2015, alleged thieves left Isabel Fuentes near death in her own home. This documentary traces how suspicions quickly fell on her circle of trust.

metas.name: Girl Climber
metas.description: Free climber Emily Harrington attempts a record-breaking climb of El Capitan in Yosemite.

metas.name: Thrash
metas.description: When a catastrophic hurricane slams a coastal town, stranded residents must survive rapidly rising waters swarming with ravenous sharks.

metas.name: The Last House
metas.description: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

metas.name: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
metas.description: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

metas.name: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
metas.description: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

metas.name: GOAT
metas.description: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

metas.name: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool
metas.description: Lainey Wilson redefines what it means to be a modern country star while exploring her struggles and triumphs at a pivotal career moment.

metas.name: Ustaad Bhagat Singh
metas.description: Inspired by his teacher, who named him Bhagat Singh and shaped his values, a tribal boy grows up rooted in strong morals and unwavering courage. Standing firm against injustice, he takes on evil forces despite overwhelming odds.

metas.name: Crowyokan
metas.description: Comedian Pandji Pragiwaksono turns spontaneous audience exchanges into an intimate and unpredictable crowd-work special.

metas.name: Ohh My Dog
metas.description: A young child forms an unexpected bond with a stray dog, embarking on an adventure that reveals the profound ways animals and humans can heal each other's hearts.

metas.name: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
metas.description: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

metas.name: Tribeca 25
metas.description: Twenty-five years after 9/11, Tribeca 25 chronicles how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, the film explores how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

metas.name: Janelle James: How Romantic
metas.description: In her debut hour-long stand-up special, Janelle James sounds off on body counts, bank accounts and why women should wrestle men.

metas.name: Joe's College Road Trip
metas.description: To teach his sheltered grandson about the real world, Madea's foul-mouthed brother Joe takes the college-bound teen on a raucous cross-country road trip.

metas.name: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
metas.description: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

metas.name: Overacting
metas.description: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

metas.name: Maa Behen
metas.description: When trouble knocks on her door, a mother and her estranged daughters attempt to cover up a crime in a nosy colony where no secret is safe.

metas.name: Kylie - Tension Tour Live
metas.description: It's time to hit the dancefloor as pop superstar Kylie Minogue shares a vibrant, exclusive behind-the-scenes look at her smash 2025 Tension World Tour.

metas.name: This Is I
metas.description: Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.

metas.name: Reminders of Him
metas.description: When Diem's custodial grandparents adamantly refuse Kenna's attempts to see her daughter, Kenna discovers unexpected compassion, and then something truer and deeper, with former NFL player and local bar owner Ledger. As their secret romance develops, so do the dangers for both of them, leading Kenna toward heartbreak and, ultimately, the hope for a second chance.

metas.name: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
metas.description: Comedian Maria Bamford weaves her mental health experiences into hilarious, uplifting comedy, showing how she channels personal vulnerability into artistic power through raw authenticity.

metas.name: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
metas.description: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.

metas.name: Feel My Voice
metas.description: Sarah Toscano stars as Eletta, the only hearing member of a deaf family. When a singing teacher (Serena Rossi) discovers her extraordinary voice, Eletta faces the heartbreaking choice between her dream and her family.

metas.name: Golden Kamuy -The Abashiri Prison Raid-
metas.description: As each group pursues their mission, a fierce battle unfolds over the tattooed prisoners. Who is friend, and who is foe? The fight leads them all to Abashiri Prison, where Noppera-bo, the man who holds all the answers, is locked away...

metas.name: Here the Whole Time
metas.description: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

metas.name: Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story
metas.description: Comedian Dane Cook revisits his climb from stand-up stardom—and a devastating family betrayal that cost him millions—in this candid documentary.

metas.name: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
metas.description: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.

metas.name: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
metas.description: Second City Television cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how a scrappy Canadian sketch show made comedy history.

metas.name: Desire
metas.description: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

metas.name: Animals
metas.description: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

metas.name: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
metas.description: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity.

metas.name: Never Surrender
metas.description: When a deadly gang descends on his remote home, a guilt-ridden veteran and the estranged grandchildren he barely knows must unite to survive.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: Cocktail 2
metas.description: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

metas.name: Sing Geetham
metas.description: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.

metas.name: Free Leonard Peltier
metas.description: Leonard Peltier, an activist jailed for decades after a disputed conviction, faces his twilight years as a new generation fights for his release from prison before it's too late.

metas.name: The Furious
metas.description: When YouTuber-boxer Danial insults their late father's name, brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite - one fighting for redemption, the other for revenge - in a battle that will decide not just who wins, but what remains of The Furious legacy.

metas.name: Oru Durooha Saahacharyathil
metas.description: Humble health care worker Sethu lives a quiet life caring for his sick brother — until a mysterious armed fugitive seeks refuge in his home.

metas.name: Sam Morril: Incorrect
metas.description: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.

metas.name: Don't Trust the Couple Upstairs
metas.description: Newlyweds Maria and Joe rent out part of their house to Vicki and Clay, a friendly but enigmatic couple. Living together starts well, but when Vicki is killed, Maria uncovers secrets that make her realize Joe isn't the man she married.

metas.name: The Birthday​ Gift​
metas.description: Single mother Marlene Frischmann organizes a birthday party for her son Theo at her brother's chic country villa, which quickly spirals into family drama, world-view quarrels, and chaos.

metas.name: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota
metas.description: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.

metas.name: Chatha Pacha
metas.description: Misfits in Fort Kochi unite to create a wrestling group, facing internal rivalries and funny fights as they grow to tackle greater obstacles

metas.name: The Hollywood Rabbi
metas.description: How does the child of immigrants, raised on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, become Frank Sinatra’s personal rabbi, win two Academy Awards, mingle with four kings, three popes, eight presidents and a who’s who of Hollywood royalty while dedicating his life to healing the world through tolerance?

metas.name: Barbie in the Nutcracker
metas.description: Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.

metas.name: Heartstopper Forever
metas.description: Nick and Charlie are in love, but new challenges lay ahead with Nick getting ready to leave for university and Charlie taking on new responsibilities at school.

metas.name: Mardaani 3
metas.description: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down those behind the disappearance of young girls, risking everything to bring them back alive.

metas.name: Colors of Evil: Black
metas.description: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.

metas.name: The Roast of Kevin Hart
metas.description: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

metas.name: USA 94: Brazil's Return to Glory
metas.description: This documentary revisits Brazil's journey to the 1994 World Cup, featuring interviews and never-before-seen footage shot by the players themselves.

metas.name: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
metas.description: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

metas.name: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
metas.description: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

metas.name: Kidô Senshi Gandamu Senkô no Hasauei Kirukê no Majo
metas.description: Hathaway Noa's fight against the Earth Federation continues, culminating in a terrorist attack on Adelaide's government conference. Gigi Andalucia remains crucial, her influence embodying the "witch" figure.

metas.name: People We Meet on Vacation
metas.description: Poppy's a free spirit. Alex loves a plan. After years of summer vacations, these polar-opposite pals wonder if they could be a perfect romantic match.

metas.name: Do Deewane Seher Mein
metas.description: Two socially awkward millennials in Mumbai find love while struggling with self-acceptance. As they battle insecurities and societal pressure, their journey takes them from city chaos to mountain serenity.

metas.name: Dilwali Diwali
metas.description: Ansh Sikkha returns to his Punjabi family home for Diwali after years working abroad. As the Sikkas gather for the festival, their clashing views on what constitutes a fulfilling life create friction and connection.

metas.name: Vice & Virtue
metas.description: When celestial rivals Vice and Virtue bet on the fate of six unsuspecting humans, chaos ensues and secrets unravel. As free will collides with divine meddling, lives spiral in this darkly comedic tale of power, morality, and choice.

metas.name: Lure
metas.description: After being invited to a party by a mysterious and alluring woman, six men awake to find themselves part of a cult family's gruesome annual tradition to find the perfect suitor.

metas.name: Death by Fruitcake
metas.description: During the dress rehearsal for a festive Christmas play in small-town Serenity, Iowa, star Louise Lamont topples over after a bite of prop pastry. Since the frosty actress had earned plenty of enemies through her offstage dramatics, the cast of suspects is longer than Santa's "Naughty or Nice" list. Prop mistress Brandy Borne and her diva-turned-director mother, Vivian-assisted by their savvy shih tzu, Sushi-must solve this fruitcake fatality before it's curtains for anyone else.

metas.name: Thingy
metas.description: Desperate to avoid her ex at a secluded house party, a young woman finds an unexpected ally when a supernatural virus begins infecting the guests.

metas.name: Heart of a Woman
metas.description: Naomi, a devoted nurse, uncovers her husband's betrayal and transforms from an abused wife into a relentless force for revenge and justice.

metas.name: Brendan Eyre: Alive and Well
metas.description: From Snakes wearing coats to being bipolar,Brendan Eyre's laid back, observational style covers both the silly and the serious with equal hilarity. From the burden of owning a cast iron skillet, passive aggressive elevator behavior, and the product selection at Marshall's, to escaping the psych ward and shock therapy, Brendan keeps the audience engaged and delighted in his must-watch special.

metas.name: Gloria
metas.description: Alex looks back on the love he and Gloria forged as teenagers in the 1930s. Years of passion and conflict have fractured their family, and now, late in life, he must face the pain he caused his adult children.

metas.name: Bits & Pieces
metas.description: In his first self-produced special, filmed at the Comedy Cellar, Jourdain riffs on life as a Southern transplant in New York. His hilarious hour covers strict parents, growing up poor, politics, and high school struggles with sharp, fearless humor.

metas.name: Operation Psionics: The Psychic War for UFOs
metas.description: Former US operative in charge of a UAP recovery team who interacted with and retrieved craft that contained non-human biologics, now summons UAP at will.

metas.name: Vibeland Chronicles
metas.description: A mysterious force descends upon a small town, warping the minds of its inhabitants as the boundaries between what's real and what's imagined begin to blur, leaving residents trapped in their darkest fixations.

metas.name: Nephilim: Giants Who Ruled the Earth
metas.description: The story of celestial rebellion, of Giants who once walked the Earth and of the ancient lore and the mysteries unfolding in our skies today.

metas.name: Finding Harmony: A King's Vision
metas.description: In an unprecedented portrait of King Charles III, Finding Harmony: A King's Vision provides intimate insight into His Majesty's passionate quest to reunite humanity with nature. Academy Award-winner Kate Winslet narrates this journey through The King's Foundation's vital work.

metas.name: Looters
metas.description: Amateur pickpockets Oli and E are forced to take in an overly ambitious newcomer Cass. The shifting dynamics become an ample opportunity for master criminal Neil to manipulate the young group forcing them to take more than they can handle.

metas.name: Love in Paradise
metas.description: Lars is about to marry Bella, but one thing bothers him: his mother has been single for a while. To avoid leaving her alone, he invites her on a sunny vacation to Curaçao. What he doesn't tell her? It's actually a solo trip for singles.

metas.name: Home Delivery
metas.description: A plus-size supermodel invites her family over to experience the birth of her first child.

metas.name: Bad Men Must Bleed
metas.description: After a young girl’s family is brutally murdered by ruthless outlaw Harrison Griggs, she forms an unlikely bond with a haunted Civil War veteran turned fugitive known as 'The Butcher'. Together, they must stop Griggs and his gang before he seizes control of the town.

metas.name: Faithful Intentions
metas.description: She thought she won a dream weekend. The intruders think she's someone else—and the lie keeping her alive could expose the affair that started it all.

metas.name: 12 Hours in October
metas.description: Inspired by the events of October 7, 2023, it depicts the separate points of view of different characters as they face the terror and chaos of the first twelve hours of that fateful day.

metas.name: The American Coyote
metas.description: As he was heading to America, 9 year-old Efrain escapes and heads into the woods.

metas.name: Lazarus: The Awakening
metas.description: A vigilante resurrected from death hunts a drug empire in Jackson, clashing with a kingpin, a reporter, and a city consumed by fentanyl. Justice becomes war.

metas.name: TT for Life
metas.description: TT FOR LIFE plunges into the Isle of Man TT, the world's most dangerous motorbike race, through a small team. With Curinga and Shaun Anderson, triumphs and disasters collide in a human drama and cinematic portrait of road-racing passion.

metas.name: Broken Years
metas.description: In the shadow of the 1975 embargo, theater actor Aytekin unwittingly becomes the star of the erotic film craze while trying to protect his family.

metas.name: Traction Park Massacre
metas.description: A group of teens set out to the ruins of an abandoned amusement park that burned down fifteen years earlier. The incident is known to have killed two brothers who were trapped inside, but the brothers survived and now haunt the park.

metas.name: Learning to Fly
metas.description: Former competitive runner turned photographer Aisha McAdams documents elite ultra marathon athletes. After trauma forced her from the sport, she wonders if she can find her way back by entering an ultra-marathon herself.

metas.name: The Napa Boys
metas.description: Jack Jr, Miles Jr and the whole gang are back for one last wine-soaked journey prompted by the mysterious "Sommelier." Joined this time by Puck, a fan of The Napa Boys comics, the group will learn about love, loss, friendship and viticulture.

metas.name: The Estate
metas.description: This contemporary social thriller is the story of the plight of the Wellsleys, an aristocratic family who are unable to save their ancestral estate due to insurmountable debts.

metas.name: Final Orbit
metas.description: Across a dying Earth and the far reaches of space, humanity faces its final tests. Stranded astronauts, desperate survivors, conflicted pilots and an isolated diplomat must decide what is worth saving before time runs out.

metas.name: Breach
metas.description: Five haunting visions of the future collide in this gripping sci-fi anthology where technology spirals out of control, society begins to collapse, and humanity is pushed to its limits.

metas.name: The Living Corpse
metas.description: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death.

metas.name: The Twist
metas.description: A dark rooted counselor runs a center for troubled women and protects her clients in a twisted way.

metas.name: Worlds Apart
metas.description: Worlds Apart is an animated sci-fi anthology exploring three distant worlds and one uncertain future. From a lonely scientist stranded on Europa, to a young woman escaping an oppressive post-apocalyptic society with a decommissioned military droid, to a cadet caught between a secretive agency and an alien encounter, three characters are forced to question the worlds they have been told to trust.

metas.name: The Random Guest
metas.description: A lonely wife who can't seem to get her busy husband's attention falls for a man who stays in the same guest house. What she doesn't realize is that he set to be there not for her.

metas.name: Basibozuklar
metas.description: It recounts the absurd and comical events that unfold when an amateur music band, setting out with the intention of performing a concert in Alaçatı, loses their way and accidentally arrives at an American missile base in Syria.

metas.name: Psychic Agent: The Gate Program
metas.description: As America's government psychic spy program operated in secrecy, children across the country were being labeled gifted, tested, and observed. This documentary explores whether the two worlds were more connected than anyone imagined.

metas.name: Desert Fiends 2
metas.description: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

metas.name: Play or Get Played
metas.description: Ava Cooper is caught in a web of love, betrayal, and hidden secrets as a dangerous affair forces her to question everyone around her.

metas.name: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
metas.description: When a behavioral science major investigates murders at Capps Crossing, she finds herself trapped in a twisted web of lies surrounding the local ranger and his son.

metas.name: Eddie B: If These Classroom Walls Could Talk
metas.description: If These Classroom Walls Could Talk is a collection of real stories from teachers across the country, navigating the ups and downs of the classroom with humor and heart. From hilarious student encounters to unforgettable moments with parents and administrators, this special highlights the shared experiences that connect educators everywhere. Whether you're a teacher, a parent, or anyone who's ever set foot in a classroom, one lesson stands out above all: teachers deserve a raise! Honest, engaging, and deeply relatable, If These Walls Could Talk is a testament to the resilience, passion, and undeniable impact of educators.

metas.name: The Outlaw in Me
metas.description: The Outlaw in Me shares a journey with Marchella as she delves into the fascinating world of Outlaws, exploring a subculture of car owners who modify their machines with varying degrees of artistic personalisation.

metas.name: He's Watching You
metas.description: A teenager investigating mysterious murders in his small town discovers a collection of VHS tapes that could reveal the identity of a notorious serial killer.

metas.name: A Single Christian
metas.description: A faithful woman falls for a man with a dark secret, then discovers she's caught in spiritual warfare-and perhaps facing mortal danger.

metas.name: Anaconda: Blood Coil
metas.description: A group of friends are terrorized by an anaconda during their vacation.

metas.name: Time of Death
metas.description: When a prisoner vanishes without a trace, Detective Frank Morley (Michael Kelly) is sent to a decaying prison on the verge of shutdown. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a dangerous search for answers.

metas.name: Cursed Waters
metas.description: Shipwrecked pirates fleeing the Navy wash ashore on a remote island, only to discover it's home to a bloodthirsty cult guarding secrets no one was meant to find. Now survival means escaping both the law and something far worse.

metas.name: Hamlet
metas.description: Hamlet comes home for his father's funeral and finds his uncle Claudius marrying his widowed mother Gertrude. His father's ghost reveals Claudius murdered him, leading Hamlet toward revenge and introspection.

metas.name: Misdirection
metas.description: A desperate couple have pulled off a string of high-end break-ins to pay off a mob debt. When they attempt to rob their latest victim, they find themselves caught in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The tables are turned and the hunters become the hunted.

metas.name: Butchers Book Three: Bonesaw
metas.description: Three women find themselves being hunted by a vicious killer who slaughters people and hacks them up in his van, while a clever sheriff pieces together the clues he's leaving behind.

metas.name: Meal Ticket
metas.description: Follows the history of the McDonald's All American Games, the annual basketball exhibitions of next-generation talent that have catapulted high school seniors into the NBA and WNBA since 1977.

metas.name: Addition
metas.description: Grace Lisa Vandenburg counts everything - the letters in her name, the poppy seeds on her orange cake. She counts because numbers hold the world together. But when a chance encounter with Seamus turns her world upside down, Grace's meticulously ordered life starts to unravel.

metas.name: Stephen Taylor: The Bottom Half
metas.description: A reformed preacher and a former political operative, Stephen Taylor moved out of Louisiana to escape his traditional southern roots. The Bottom Half dives deep, sometime too deep, into that journey. Live from the Barrel of the Bottoms in Kansas City, Stephen mixes stand up and storytelling with some sweet southern charm while touching on everything from Beta Fish and Bidets to the National Black Rodeo.

metas.name: A Paralyzing Redemption
metas.description: A star basketball player finds his world turned upside down when a serious car accident leaves him a quadriplegic.

metas.name: Mr. Wonderful
metas.description: Three generations of men—a millennial on the run from a drug dealer; his father, a jaded professor trying to keep his job; and the family patriarch fighting senility—all struggle to find meaning in life.

metas.name: Balls Up
metas.description: Two marketers pitch a bold new condom World Cup sponsorship. After a booze-fueled scandal, they must outrun chaos to survive.

metas.name: Feed
metas.description: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

metas.name: The Shepherd Code: Lapierre
metas.description: Lewis enlists his top agent, Alex Lapierre - aka "The Shepherd" - for a mission that's as high-stakes as it is dangerous: eliminate a list of targets for Tania Edwards, a powerful and enigmatic woman tangled in a massive scandal. But things quickly take an unexpected turn. A mysterious bounty hunter, known only as "The Ghost," enters the picture with a very different agenda: to take out both Tania and Alex, but on whose behalf? Caught between the conflicting demands of his superiors and his own growing doubts, Alex faces a tough decision: follow orders and remain the loyal soldier he's trained to be, or be swayed by Tania's allure and question everything he believes in.

metas.name: Pretty Lethal
metas.description: A group of ballerinas try to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.

metas.name: Kill Code
metas.description: North America has been divided into four main quadrants. A power-hungry corporation has taken over the conventional prison system and made criminals the new law enforcers.  The owner of that corporation, nanoscientist Eion Prescott, created a nano-virus called Onyx. Which is distributed through deadly watches to criminals. First, infecting them. Then, forcing them into eliminating each other for freedom. Who can topple the corporation's entire system from within?

metas.name: Couples Weekend
metas.description: What happens when a tree falls in the woods and someone does hear it? Two couples are forced to deal with such a question — and their lives in general — when a New Year's Eve trip to the woods unearths simmering feelings and the secrets they carry threaten to break their seemingly perfect relationships.

metas.name: Kraken
metas.description: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

metas.name: Love Reins at Christmas
metas.description: A widowed mother, Grace Guidry, is struggling to keep her family farm running. Throughout the holiday season, she must navigate the immense challenges of farm life and the complexities of finding hope and love again.

metas.name: Jen Kober: Uber Famous
metas.description: Uber Famous is Jen Kober at her most honest and joyful- sharing stories about family, identity, and the beautifully messy road to self-acceptance. With warmth, wit, and fearless humor, she finds the comedy in everyday life and unexpected fame.

metas.name: Vengeance
metas.description: The brutal murder of the wife of “Toro,” a military hero in the special forces, turns him into a man with a single purpose: revenge. After a stroke of fate makes him a millionaire, Carlos transforms his fortune into an arsenal and, together with his closest soldiers, sets out to hunt down those responsible.

metas.name: Love of Your Life
metas.description: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

metas.name: Wuthering Heights
metas.description: Tragedy strikes when Heathcliff falls in love with Catherine Earnshaw, a woman from a wealthy family in 18th-century England.

metas.name: The Gates
metas.description: Three friends' road trip turns terrifying when they witness a murder in a gated community. Trapped inside, hunted by residents who blame them, their bond fractures as a charismatic yet sinister patriarch closes in.

metas.name: The Deadly Little Mermaid
metas.description: Some secrets are better left at the bottom of the ocean. Once she's in your house, there is no escape. When a struggling artist pulls a beautiful, unconscious woman from the freezing coastal waters, he thinks he’s performed a miracle. But as she recovers within the walls of his secluded home, a series of unsettling events leads him to a terrifying realization: her presence is no coincidence. She is inextricably linked to the same watery grave that claimed his family years ago.

metas.name: The Devil's Mouth
metas.description: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

metas.name: Scream 7
metas.description: Sidney fights to protect her daughter when Ghostface stalks their quiet Indiana town, forcing a survivor's family to confront old trauma, media spectacle, and a killer who weaponizes deep-fakes.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

metas.name: Barreda
metas.description: In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

metas.name: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest
metas.description: A rational urban man defies his ancestral village's forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, forcing him to confront powers beyond logic as he becomes the unlikely saviour protecting his people from annihilation.

metas.name: Dinosaur Hunt
metas.description: A rich family are brought together to a remote island for a reunion, only to learn that their father has been experimenting with dinosaurs in an attempt to find a cure for his disease. This family are forced to work together when the dinosaurs escape.

metas.name: The Bride!
metas.description: A lonely Frankenstein travels to 1930s Chicago to ask groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious to create a companion for him. The two revive a murdered young woman and The Bride is born. But what ensues is beyond what either of them imagined.

metas.name: Governor
metas.description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

metas.name: ASI Babita Singh Reporting
metas.description: An under-estimated cop visiting her in-laws for the first time finds herself torn between uncovering the truth in a murder investigation and the hidden lies in her own marriage.

metas.name: Dug Dug
metas.description: Mysterious events in the wake of a freak motorcycle accident sow the seeds of a new religion.

metas.name: By Design
metas.description: A woman swaps bodies with a chair, and everyone likes her better as a chair.

metas.name: JACK AND AVA
metas.description: Jack is an orphan. Ava is a survivor. Together, they’re lovers on the run after stealing a cache of illegal firearms from two local rednecks—and they just made enemies out of the wrong crew. With their friend Will in tow and corrupt cops closing in, the next 72 hours will test their limits, their loyalties, and their shot at redemption.

metas.name: Gaijin
metas.description: Traveling to a legendary temple in Japan to kill himself, an American grad student has his suicide attempt interrupted by the spirit of his dead twin who issues the challenge: Hang on till cherry blossom season.

metas.name: The Hunting Club
metas.description: A revenge drama about a father who loses his daughter in the worst imaginable way. When the system fails to serve justice, he and a group of fathers who have been through similar ordeals decide to get justice their own way.

metas.name: Time Travel Man: Al Bielek and the Philadelphia Experiment
metas.description: A man was thrust forty years into the future after a classified naval experiment ripped open a temporal doorway into time and space. This is the real Philadelphia Experiment and the mystery of Montauk Island.

metas.name: Peter and the Goblin Arrow
metas.description: When a mighty Dwarven warrior falls victim to a goblin's poisoned arrow, his weakling son must embark on a perilous quest to gather three ingredients needed to save his father's life before dawn breaks and all hope is lost.

metas.name: Bigfoot I Love You
metas.description: When two young filmmakers search for Bigfoot in the forests of Normandy, they first must get through the crazy French townspeople who guard his secret.

metas.name: Drip Drop
metas.description: Things take a left turn when the wife of a wealthy self-made entrepreneur offers her best friend and her best friend's husband the opportunity of a life-time: a swinger's weekend for $200,000. Her friend accepts the offer, and chaos ensues soon thereafter, threatening the lives of all involved.

metas.name: Dead Bloom
metas.description: Dead Bloom unfolds as a socially charged horror story about the lingering effects of environmental contamination and corporate denial.

metas.name: Hallucinations of War
metas.description: Emily returns home after her mother's death, only to face her estranged twin sister and her sister's new boyfriend, who manipulates her into questioning her reality.

metas.name: Pitfall
metas.description: After a young man gets separated from his friends while in the woods, he falls into a 10-foot deep pit of spikes, impaling him through the leg, and leaving him trapped. He quickly learns that his fall was not an accident.

metas.name: Surfacing
metas.description: After years of battling severe depression, a young man learns to love himself and accept love from others after becoming caught in his therapist's personal life and recognizing her need for similar help.

metas.name: Where is Mr Right
metas.description: Successful event planner Bunmi longs for love and a family. Drawn into the seemingly perfect marriage of her neighbors, Bridget and Femi.When Bridget introduces her to her charming brother, Dexy, and draws her into a dark secret involving her husband, Bunmi is forced to confront the dangerous illusion of "perfect love," as she is caught in a web of deception where love, illusion and danger collide

metas.name: The Reality Experiment
metas.description: Eight strangers gather for an unknown experiment at the University for a quick payday. However, things rapidly get out of control as reality itself begins to turn on them.

metas.name: The Crown's Church
metas.description: When the Pope refused Henry VIII's annulment, Henry declared himself Supreme Head of the Church of England and cut England loose from nearly a thousand years of Catholic tradition. From that fracture came something that could not be controlled: the English Bible, placed in the hands of ordinary people. Discover how a royal marriage crisis reshaped faith, power, and the way a nation read Scripture forever.

metas.name: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
metas.description: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

metas.name: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He’s here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. As he gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, he learns about the unexpected challenges the species endures.

metas.name: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
metas.description: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

metas.name: Disneyland Handcrafted
metas.description: Oscar and Emmy nominated filmmaker Leslie Iwerks returns with an all-new Disney documentary giving viewers an up-close look at the dedication, effort, and passion that was required to realize a dream that would go on to inspire millions around the world.

metas.name: WWE Clash in Italy
metas.description: Clash in Italy is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. The event takes place on Sunday, May 31, 2026, at the Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy.

metas.name: National Geographic Museum of Exploration
metas.description: Step inside the National Geographic Museum of Exploration with National Geographic Explorer Andrés Ruzo alongside “Descendants: Wicked Wonderland” actress Kiara Romero. Disney+ Insider unveils a space designed to spark curiosity and inspire discovery. From the museum’s striking, canyon-inspired architecture to its four thematic areas—Spark, Trek, Purpose, and Impact—each experience highlights the power of exploration. Along the way, rare artifacts, hands-on interactive spaces, and immersive exhibitions bring science, storytelling, and conservation to life. The experience builds to a powerful invitation: to see the world differently, embrace an Explorer’s mindset, and step into a future shaped by curiosity, wonder, and purpose.

metas.name: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
metas.description: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

metas.name: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
metas.description: Two gangsters and the woman they love try to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine.

metas.name: The Punisher: One Last Kill
metas.description: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

metas.name: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
metas.description: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

metas.name: Orangutan
metas.description: Narrated by Josh Gad, journey high into the rainforest canopy of Southeast Asia where a magnificent and mysterious community filled with playful personalities lives. Witness the exhilarating action, heartwarming encounters, and a closeup look at a stunning jungle teeming with wildlife as the inquisitive adolescent orangutan Indah prepares to leave her family and venture out on her own for the first time.

metas.name: The Muppet Show
metas.description: Music, comedy, and a whole lot of chaos is bound to ensue when The Muppets once again take the stage of the original Muppet Theatre with their very special guest, Sabrina Carpenter!

metas.name: Cars: Spooky Halloween Adventure
metas.description: It's Halloween night in Radiator Springs, and Lightning and his best friend Mater are enjoying the festivities at the annual spooky block party. But when Lightning gets bored of the flavored gasoline, roasted lug nuts, and jack-cone-lanterns, he convinces Mater to check out the old haunted garage on the edge of town. Will the two friends be brave enough to make it through the night without getting spooked?

metas.name: The Mandalorian and Grogu
metas.description: Once a lone bounty hunter, Mandalorian Din Djarin and his apprentice Grogu embark on an exciting new Star Wars adventure.

metas.name: Frozen: Biggest Sledding Adventure Ever!
metas.description: Elsa magically creates winter sledding fun for Anna and Olaf.

metas.name: Expedition: Saving Our Seas
metas.description: Follows National Geographic Explorers investigating the global Ocean from seashore to seafloor as they chase discoveries and solutions needed to protect the seas amid rapid environmental change. Genre: Documentary, Adventure

metas.name: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
metas.description: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

metas.name: Spark Into a Flame
metas.description: Lin-Manuel Miranda and others set hip-hop and Broadway on fire in The Hamilton Mixtape.

metas.name: A Proud Family Wizmas
metas.description: When Penny Proud’s rant about Wizmas and the commercialization of Christmas causes Santa to quit on Christmas eve, Penny finds herself guilted into putting on the red suit and replacing him. And in the process of delivering Yuletide cheer with the help of Santa’s irreverent elves, she discovers that indeed the Christmas spirit is still alive.

metas.name: Rapunzel & Maximus's First Day of Spring
metas.description: It’s the first day of Spring, and while Rapunzel gets crafty with flowers, Maximus can't stop sneezing! Join Rapunzel and Maximus as they learn that together that showing up for true friendship is always worth it.

metas.name: Time and Water
metas.description: An Icelandic writer preserves vanishing glaciers, departed grandparents, family memories, and flowing time in his personal archives, transforming loss into a time capsule.

metas.name: WrestleMania 42
metas.description: CM Punk is set to go head-to-head against Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania. Randy Orton will challenge Cody Rhodes for the Undisputed WWE Championship. Plus Liv Morgan will challenge Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer in a highly personal showdown, WWE Women's Champion Jade Cargill battles Rhea Ripley in a highly-anticipated title fight.

metas.name: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
metas.description: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

metas.name: Disney Worldbuilders
metas.description: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

metas.name: Descendants/Zombies Worlds Collide: Concert Special
metas.description: Fans can experience the electrifying live concert tour that brought together beloved characters and hit songs from Disney's "Descendants" and "ZOMBIES" franchises, captured after its successful run through 40+ North American venues.

metas.name: WWE Money in the Bank
metas.description: A career-defining opportunity awaits in New Orleans as Superstars collide for a coveted World Title Contract in the Money in the Bank Ladder Matches.

metas.name: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
metas.description: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

metas.name: A Disney Holiday Short: The Invisible Horse
metas.description: Jack, a boy who believes he's outgrown the magic of Christmas, is drawn into an adventure by a mysterious invisible creature that rekindles his imagination and brings him closer to his family.

metas.name: Hoppers
metas.description: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

metas.name: Stitch & Angel's Perfect Summer Day
metas.description: Stitch & Angel decide to have the perfect summer day! When they try to play volleyball, drink smoothies, and build sandcastles, Stitch's chaos gets the best of them! Eventually Experiments 626 (Stitch) and 624 (Angel) learn that what makes the perfect summer day is enjoying it TOGETHER. Celebrate 626 Day with Stitch and Angel!

metas.name: The Pastor Who Preys
metas.description: Budding New York fashion designer, Nicole, relocates to a small lake-side town for the summer to work on her first collection and spend time with her cousin, Amanda. Once in town, Nicole also meets the charismatic pastor from Amanda's church, Caleb, and his friendly wife, Jenn. However, when Amanda turns up dead in mysterious accident, Nicole begins to suspect that something is off with the handsome pastor and wonders if he could be connected to her cousin's death.

metas.name: Camp Rock 3
metas.description: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

metas.name: Soy Luna Temporadas 1, 2, 3 Recap
metas.description: Soy Luna tells the story of Luna Valente, a teenage girl who lives and dreams on roller skates. Over three seasons, Luna and her friends experience adventures, fall in love, sing and dance, and, above all, fly on wheels at the legendary Jam and Roller rink. Before filming again... relive the best moments.

metas.name: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
metas.description: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

metas.name: Versa
metas.description: A young couple looking to start a family who experience emotions—from grief and loss to ultimate joy—as they embark on an ethereal, abstract, and imaginative cosmic dance of life.

metas.name: Kiff: The Haunting of Miss McGravy's House
metas.description: Kiff and her friends decide to "haunt" Miss McGravy's house to scare off the new owners and stop them from tearing down the beloved treehouse in the backyard. Unbeknownst to them, the house is already inhabited by ghosts who also want to protect their home, leading to a mix of fake and real hauntings. A double-length animated Halloween special episode of the Disney Channel series Kiff. Released on October 5, 2024.

metas.name: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
metas.description: Filmed in front of a live studio audience and hosted by Alex Cooper of 'Call Her Daddy' fame, Miley Cyrus reflects on the creation and impact of the series with never-before-seen archival footage, all the while interacting and reminiscing on some of the show's most memorable sets 'brought back to life' — including the Stewart family living room and the legendary Hannah Montana closet.

metas.name: Jeff Dunham: 250th Red, White, and Blue Birthday Special
metas.description: America is turning 250, and the guys and I figured there was only one way to mark the occasion!  Come join me, Walter, Peanut, Achmed, and Bubba J, for my all-new standup special: Jeff Dunham's 250th Red, White, and Blue Birthday Special. Here’s the cool part: It was last minute, so we shot the entire thing on iPhones!  Call your friends, fire up the grill (or order pizza!), and grab a front-row seat… This is one fun show you won't want to miss! Happy 250th Birthday, America!

metas.name: Vanessa Gonzalez: Mamona
metas.description: Raised by a devout Catholic mother and witch grandmother, Vanessa Gonzalez shares hilarious stories of growing up on the Texas border, family chaos, cultural expectations, and finding the courage to chase her own dreams.

metas.name: Busboys
metas.description: A pair of idiot friends believe that if they become waiters, all of their problems will be solved. They aren't entirely wrong, but they aren't entirely right.

metas.name: Solo Mio
metas.description: Left heartbroken in Rome after a wedding disaster, a stranded groom finds his ruined honeymoon transformed by a determined local and a few meddling travelers-proving that sometimes heartbreak is only the beginning.

metas.name: Desert Warrior
metas.description: In 7th-century Arabia, Princess Hind becomes a warrior to defy the ruthless Emperor Kisra. Forged into a warrior and aided by legendary bandit Hanzala, Hind unites warring tribes for a last stand—the historic Battle of Dhi Qar—that will change history.

metas.name: Dridam
metas.description: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

metas.name: Hokum
metas.description: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

metas.name: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
metas.description: A 'Man from the Future' arrives at an LA diner where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intelligence.

metas.name: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
metas.description: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

metas.name: Vaazha II: Biopic of a Billion Bros
metas.description: Four friends labeled as losers and troublemakers embark on an emotional journey of self-discovery as they face mounting social pressure. They learn to embrace their responsibilities and find success on their own terms.

metas.name: Bride or Die
metas.description: A bachelorette getaway turns into a living nightmare when a man breaks in and tries to kill bride-to-be Allie. Now trapped with a murderer in the house, the friends get put to the test as they find themselves in a deadly fight for survival.

metas.name: Ultorath
metas.description: Three generations confront conflict under one roof until one incident bridges their divide, proving patience and understanding can transform relationships.

metas.name: Dolly
metas.description: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
metas.description: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

metas.name: The RajaSaab
metas.description: Seeking his lost grandfather, a young man enters a haunted mansion and awakens a family curse powerful enough to upend both his life and reality.

metas.name: Olmo
metas.description: When Olmo gets invited to a party by his beautiful neighbor, he will do whatever he can to meet up with her, embarking on a night of laughs and chaos.

metas.name: Thaai Kizhavi
metas.description: An elderly and feared moneylender from a village near Madurai falls seriously ill, prompting her estranged sons and extended family to reunite after years of separation. As tensions rise inside the household, hidden motives, family conflicts, and expectations over her wealth turn her uncertain condition into the center of a chaotic family drama.

metas.name: Maa Inti Bangaram
metas.description: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

metas.name: Clown Panic
metas.description: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.

metas.name: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

metas.name: Never Change!
metas.description: Nearly two decades after a devastating tornado abruptly cut their senior year short, a group of mid-30s adults must return to their hometown high school to complete their remaining requirements and finally graduate.

metas.name: Signal One
metas.description: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

metas.name: Neglected
metas.description: Detective Shaw discovers a serial killer has buried his son alive and must solve three murders to find him before he dies.

metas.name: Uyir
metas.description: Follows Ajeeb, a sub-inspector serving his probationary period at the Dharmadam Police Station in Kannur district, based on real incidents.

metas.name: Mango Pachcha
metas.description: Set in Mysuru, a crime drama unfolds across a decade (2001-2011), following a chain of events that builds tension over time. The city's setting plays a key role in reflecting different phases across the years.

metas.name: Vijaynagar'er Hirey
metas.description: When a man embarks on a relaxing trip with his nephew, it quickly turns into a dangerous game of life and death as they find themselves in the middle of a mystery involving a rare diamond.

metas.name: Welcome to the Jungle
metas.description: Follows a group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out

metas.name: Chand Mera Dil
metas.description: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

metas.name: One Spoon of Chocolate
metas.description: After serving his country in the Army, Unique is falsely accused of assault and sent to prison. Once released, Unique sets up shop in Ohio to restart his life, linking up with his only surviving relative, Ramsey. There’s something insidious happening in this town, though, as its racist sheriff and his crew of similarly bigoted acolytes all have a knack for violence and share a gruesome secret pertaining to a recent string of missing young Black men. When they set their sights on Unique and turn his life upside down, the former soldier has no choice but to bring the ruckus down on the sheriff and his goons.

metas.name: Super Troopers 3
metas.description: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

metas.name: Mama's Little Murderer
metas.description: A devoted single mother, Constance, struggles to balance her newfound love with Leo and the obsessive, destructive behavior of her son, Anthony, who will go to extreme lengths to keep her to himself.

metas.name: Prathichaya
metas.description: After Kerala’s Chief Minister dies in a scandal engineered by a ruthless media tycoon, his son a brilliant tech entrepreneur enters the blood-soaked arena of politics to expose the conspiracy, vindicate his father, and turn technology against those who weaponized it

metas.name: Nikki Glaser: Good Girl
metas.description: Considered one of the most fearless voices in modern comedy, Nikki Glaser delivers a brutally honest special that takes on aging, beauty, and fame - confronting what it means to stay relevant, desirable, and real in a culture that never looks away.

metas.name: Razor
metas.description: When a little girl is hunted to be killed by a powerful politician and his ruthless criminal network, an unassuming dog groomer becomes her guardian angel as her fate dangles between survival and certain death.

metas.name: Sharks: Reef Rivals
metas.description: Follows scientists investigating why huge numbers of sharks gather in a dangerous lagoon on Australia's Great Barrier Reef, revealing a complex battleground.

metas.name: Bob the Drag Queen: This is Wild
metas.description: The incredibly talented and humble Bob the Drag Queen showcases her stand-up in this special you won’t want to miss! Non-stop jokes, brilliant wit, and perfect comedic timing keep her audience begging for more. She shares her intimate moments, relatable trauma, and how life is today as a millennial in the spotlight.

metas.name: Kidnapping My Own Daughter
metas.description: A devoted CPS worker and her family are taken hostage by two desperate parents searching for their wrongfully removed child, exposing a cover-up that threatens her career--and life.

metas.name: Untitled Home Invasion Romance
metas.description: As a last-ditch attempt to save his failing marriage, an actor stages a home invasion during a romantic getaway weekend.

metas.name: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
metas.description: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.

metas.name: Soulm8te
metas.description: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

metas.name: Return to Silent Hill
metas.description: When a man receives a mysterious letter from his lost love, he is drawn to Silent Hill, a once familiar town now consumed by darkness.

metas.name: Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience
metas.description: Featuring the global K-Pop sensation Stray Kids and a live performance from their record-breaking world tour, alongside exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and intimate interviews with the band, Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience is an epic concert film that gives fans both a spectacular front-row seat and unique access to their favourite band.

metas.name: Jetlee
metas.description: An attendant on a flight from Dubai to Kochi gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

metas.name: KPop Shark Heroes
metas.description: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.

metas.name: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
metas.description: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

metas.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
metas.description: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

metas.name: #Skyking
metas.description: A troubled airport worker's impulsive decision to steal and fly a commercial plane becomes a gripping aerial drama that reflects deeper issues of mental health and working-class struggles in America.

metas.name: The Body in the Locker
metas.description: When Amy, the CEO of a major charity, loses her father, she's shocked to discover he owned a mysterious storage locker with a deadly secret inside - the body of a woman. Was her father a murderer? Who was this woman?

metas.name: The Wizard of the Kremlin
metas.description: In the chaos of post-Soviet Russia, rising KGB officer Vladimir Putin joins forces with master manipulator Vadim Baranov to reshape life behind the Iron Curtain, using violence and deception to change the world forever.

metas.name: They Fight
metas.description: Reformed ex-convict Walt Manigan returns home to rebuild his family with the love of his life, Ketta. His path leads him to a boxing gym inside a D.C. youth recreation center about to be closed. There, he works under the wise coach Slim to mentor a group of boys to train for the junior national boxing tournament, all leading to a showdown between best friends Quincey and Peanut as they battle for a spot on the U.S. Junior Olympic Team.

metas.name: Psycho Killer
metas.description: A police officer tracks a killer after her husband, a highway patrolman, becomes one of his victims.

metas.name: Postcards for Christmas
metas.description: Hannah Norton moves to Mistletoe Valley for the holidays to work at the post office alongside her best friend from college. She discovers that the post office is full of undeliverable mail, including several love letters from the same man. Hannah sets out to solve the mystery - with the help of Ford Montgomery, a DJ at a local radio station.

metas.name: Send Help
metas.description: Two colleagues become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash. On the island, they must overcome past grievances and work together to survive, but ultimately, it's a battle of wills and wits to make it out alive.

metas.name: We Bury the Dead
metas.description: After a catastrophic military disaster reanimates the dead, Ava searches for her missing husband amidst an increasingly hostile world.

metas.name: Night Patrol
metas.description: An L.A. cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighborhood in danger.

metas.name: Jackie Fabulous: You Can Leave
metas.description: Fabulous tackles topics ranging from her ex-husband and diet pills to menopause and everyday annoyances.

metas.name: I Killed Him in My Sleep
metas.description: Millennial Kelty Crawford struggles with financial strain, career uncertainty, and a wedding she can't afford. Desperate for money, Crawford enrolls in a sleep-study experiment that spirals into terror when she experiences a vivid, violent dream of a dying man, a bloody knife in her hand, and a voice accusing her of murder.

metas.name: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy
metas.description: Amanda Knox returns to Italy to confront Giuliano Mignini, the prosecutor who locked her up for a murder she did not commit.

metas.name: Paul Simon: The Quiet Celebration Concert
metas.description: Follows Paul Simon performing his GRAMMY-nominated "Seven Psalms" live for the first time, featuring new arrangements of classics and deep cuts. Recorded at McCaw Hall in Seattle.

metas.name: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness
metas.description: A coast-to-coast event exploring Disney Parks and attractions as a portal through which America's greatest stories, triumphs and traditions are celebrated.

metas.name: Super Scam Me
metas.description: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

metas.name: Lucky the Superstar
metas.description: A stray puppy's adventure transforms lives: helping a child heal, bringing a family together, and causing political mayhem while finding her way home.

metas.name: Mexican Psycho
metas.description: Follows an "ultra-violent and intelligent" psychopath who challenges the police by leaving a white paper rabbit at each crime scene, connecting them all.

metas.name: Murder in the Highland Manor
metas.description: Kate takes a job as a live-in tutor at a secluded Scottish estate for a mother and daughter who’ve escaped domestic abuse. But when she discovers the previous au pair mysteriously disappeared, Kate becomes embroiled in the family’s deadly secrets.

metas.name: Brothers Under Fire
metas.description: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.

metas.name: Lucky Strike
metas.description: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

metas.name: Breaking Glass: The Pat Summitt Story
metas.description: Chronicles the life of the legendary Tennessee Lady Vols basketball coach.

metas.name: In the Blink of an Eye
metas.description: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection, and the circle of life.

metas.name: Crazy Magical Mexico
metas.description: A man finds the best motivation to secure and save his town: making an independent Mexican film.

metas.name: Love is Love
metas.description: Enrique Juarez is an up-and-coming Mexican Telenovela actor on the verge of becoming a leading man, that has to hide his true self in order to achieve stardom.

metas.name: Ghost Elephants
metas.description: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory.

metas.name: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
metas.description: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

metas.name: Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Runway Show
metas.description: The annual SI swimsuit fashion show presented by internationally recognized athletes, entertainers, and pop culture icons.

metas.name: My Grandfather Charles Manson
