metas.name: Who Is She?
metas.description: Megan's looks, charm and wit. What they don't see below the surface is a tormented, angry young woman with multiple personalities, who has a tendency for violence. If you ask five people who is they will give you five different answers.

metas.name: A Royal Christmas Hope
metas.description: Julia Carter, the director of a nonprofit called Hope For All, prepares for the busy Christmas season. Despite financial challenges, Julia is determined to keep the holiday spirit alive for families in need. Prince Christopher of St. Monica, seeking a break from royal duties, travels to America for a different Christmas experience. He meets Julia, and, under the guise of a tech executive, volunteers at her nonprofit. As he becomes more involved in her world, an unlikely romance blossoms between Julia and Christopher.

metas.name: Merry Little Baby
metas.description: When Shanice's baby pact she made with her best friend fails, she decides to go on a app to find a sperm donor to be her baby daddy this holiday season which also happens to be her 35th birthday.

metas.name: Ladies & Gentlemen... 50 Years of SNL Music
metas.description: Untold stories behind the culture-defining and newsmaking musical performances, sketches and cameos of the past 50 years.

metas.name: Clear the Shelters
metas.description: Heartwarming adoption stories of pets finding forever homes; celebrating the effort to clear the shelters as hundreds of rescues host adoption drives for animals in need -- from dogs and cats to birds, guinea pigs, lizards and horses.

metas.name: Grow
metas.description: In the self-proclaimed ‘Pumpkin Capital of the World’, no-nonsense curmudgeonly farmer Dinah Little takes in her estranged niece Charlie, who decides to enter the local pumpkin growing competition where she and the other growers face fierce competition, sabotage, and a genetically engineered rival.

metas.name: A Scottish Christmas Secret
metas.description: Publisher Tiffany goes to Scotland to convince her top author Nathan to finish his series. While posing as a ski student, she uncovers he's the heir to a dukedom. Romance blooms amid snowy Highland adventures.

metas.name: Reality TV Murders
metas.description: When one of the castmates of the reality TV show "Diva's Doing It" is found dead, the other women on the show become suspects.

metas.name: Dakar: Race Against the Desert
metas.description: Elite racers and emerging talents battle extreme conditions and push their limits across Saudi Arabia's unforgiving desert in the legendary Dakar Rally, where teamwork and cutting-edge tech meet raw determination.

metas.name: A Christmas Murder Mystery
metas.description: Vera Vexley is the editor of the Metropolitan Ledger’s puzzle section, and a part-time consulting detective for the local sheriff’s office. This year, she has been invited to spend the holidays with family friends, the Sterlings, a wealthy family who appears to be hiding enough secrets to stuff a sleigh. Vera soon finds herself helming a murder investigation when someone is found dead on Christmas morning, putting her at odds with the quick-tempered and distraught family members. Can Vera find the culprit before the holidays turn even more deadly?

metas.name: Diddy: The Making of a Bad Boy
metas.description: A raw, exclusive look at Sean Combs long before he was known as Puff or Diddy. Featuring never-before-seen footage and stories from those who know him best, this documentary special sheds light on his childhood, rise to fame, and recent criminal allegations, challenging viewers to rethink everything they thought they knew about the mogul behind the music—and the mugshot.

metas.name: Tinsel Town
metas.description: A washed-up Hollywood action hero is tricked into starring in a small English town’s chaotic Christmas pantomime, where a straight-talking dance instructor and his estranged daughter just might help him rediscover the magic of the season.

metas.name: The Phoenician Scheme
metas.description: Wealthy businessman Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.
